name: pi
description: AI agent toolkit: unified LLM API, agent loop, TUI, coding agent CLI
one_liner: A bare-bones, highly customizable AI coding agent that developers can reshape into exactly the tool they want, instead of accepting someone else's defaults.
buyer: A developer tooling founder who wants to build a custom AI coding product without starting from scratch.
business_use_cases: A startup builds a vertical-specific coding assistant (e.g. for a particular framework) on top of it instead of building an agent loop from scratch.
A power user builds and sells custom 'packages' (extensions/skills/themes) for others to install.
An agency offers custom AI agent setup services for clients who want something off the beaten path.

money_ideas.idea: Build and sell custom packages/extensions on npm or a marketplace for other users of the tool.
Use it as the base for a new, branded AI coding product sold as a subscription.

steal_this: This weekend, build one sharp, opinionated package for a specific niche (e.g. a Rails-focused agent persona) and publish it with a 'pro' paid tier.
